title: Add a normalize_whitespace text helper
request: Add a normalize_whitespace(text) helper under .agent-system/examples/hello-world-task/src/text_utils.py that collapses any run of whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines) into a single space and strips leading/trailing whitespace. Include a unit test.
constraints: Standard library only — no new dependency for a one-function helper.
acceptance_criteria: normalize_whitespace collapses runs of spaces, tabs, and newlines into a single space.
Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped.
A unit test exercises tabs/newlines/multi-space input, not just a single simple case, and passes.
